contexts.text: By the mountain of Zion is meant the Celestial of faith; and by the city of Zion, the Spiritual of faith. Illustrated.
The daughter of Zion () = the Celestial Church. AC 1664:4.
The mountain of Zion () = the Lord; and, derivatively, all the Celestial, which is love.
The places in the middle of Canaan... represented the Lord's internal man, as the mountain of Zion, and Jerusalem; the former, the celestial things, and the latter, the spiritual things.
Zion () = the Church, which is perishing.
Put on thy strength O Zion (); Zion = the Celestial Church; Jerusalem, the Spiritual Church.
Zion () = the Church.
The affection of good constitutes the Celestial Church, and is called, in the Word, the daughter of Zion, and the virgin daughter of Zion.
They do not perceive that mountain of Zion, or Zion, that was at Jerusalem, but the Lord's Kingdom.
The names = Things, as... Zion, the Celestial Church; Jerusalem, the Spiritual Church.
The new temple and New Jerusalem = in special, the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom; and Zion, the Celestial Kingdom.
The ways of Zion do mourn, () = that there are no longer any truths from good. Ways = truths.

After David had reigned in Hebron seven years and six months, he went to Jerusalem, and took possession of Zion (. ) and then for the first time the Lord's Spiritual Church began to be represented by Jerusalem; and His Celestial Church by Zion.
When Judah and Zion are treated of, the term nation is used, by which is signified the Celestial Church; for this Church is meant by Judah, and Zion.
The Land of Canaan represented the Lord's Kingdom; Zion, the Celestial of it; and Jerusalem, the Spiritual.
The daughter of Zion = the Celestial Church, and this from the affection of good; the daughter of Jerusalem, the Spiritual Church, from the affection of truth.
The virgin daughter of Zion () = the Celestial Church.
Hence it is said to go up from Jerusalem to Zion; and to go down from Zion to Jerusalem; for... Jerusalem = the interiors of the Church; and Zion, the inmosts of it.
The daughters of Zion exalt themselves () = the affections of evil within the Church. Described.
Jehovah will comfort Zion () = the Celestial Church. ( = the Church. AR 90:4.) ( = the Church where the Lord must be worshipped. AE 326:5.)
They were therefore restricted (in regard to their worship) to the mountain where Jerusalem was, and at last where Zion was...
As Zion = the Celestial Church, and Jerusalem the Spiritual Church, and as the Celestial Church is that which is in good from love to the Lord... strength is predicated of Zion (in ).

Jehovah shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth even to eternity... (). Here is described the Lord's Celestial Kingdom; its inmost, which is love to the Lord, by mount Zion; its derivative, which is mutual love, by the lull of the daughter of Zion, which love, in the spiritual sense, is called charity towards the neighbour... (Continued. See Jerusalem.)
The daughter of Zion, and the daughter of Judah () = the Celestial Church; here, this Church destroyed. AC 9815:2.
Zion is called the throne of Jehovah's glory in ; (and) by Zion is meant the Lord's Celestial Kingdom (where the principal thing is the Divine good from which is the Divine truth).
Zion, or the Celestial Church, and its fructification after vastation (is treated of in ).

So shall Jehovah of Hosts come down to fight upon the mountain of Zion, and upon its hill ()... the mountain of Zion = the good of the Divine love; and its hill, the derivative Divine truth. ( = the Celestial Church, and the Spiritual Church. AE 601:5.)
The daughter of Zion () = the affection of good, which is of the Celestial Church.

The mountain of Jehovah () which is Zion, = the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, thus the good of that Kingdom, which is the good of love to the Lord; thus, in the supreme sense, the Lord Himself... The like is signified by the mountain of Zion elsewhere in the Word, and by its hill, the good of mutual love; as in ... Jehovah does not fight upon the mountain of Zion... but where there is the good of love; it is for this, that is, for those in it, that the Lord fights... If He has fought for Zion and for Jerusalem, it is because they represented the Celestial Church. AE 433:19.

In order that this representative (Divine worship on mountains and hills) might be retained, the mountain of Zion was chosen, and by it, in the supreme sense, was represented the Divine good of the Lord's Divine love; and, in the relative sense, the Divine Celestial and the Divine Spiritual in His Kingdom.
Rejoice, ye sons of Zion (); sons of Zion = truths from good. (Compare AE 922:6.)
In  it treats of Zion and Jerusalem, which = the Celestial Church; Zion, its internal, and Jerusalem, its external.
Zion () = the Celestial Church; thus the good of love, which is of this Church.
The daughter of Zion () = the Church where good is.
Zion () = Heaven, where is the good of love.
The daughter of Zion () = the Celestial Church.
The daughter of Zion (treated of in ) = the Celestial Church; that is, the Church which is in love to the Lord.
The habitation of the mountain of Zion () = Heaven and the Church. ( = the good of the Celestial Church. AE 504:11. AE 594:15.)
Jehovah shall send the sceptre of strength out of Zion () = power, then, from celestial good; Zion = this good.
Jehovah hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness (); Zion = the Celestial Church (filled with) intelligence from Divine truth, and with wisdom from Divine good.
For Zion's sake I will not be silent... (). By Zion, and Jerusalem, is meant the Church; by Zion, the Celestial Church; and by Jerusalem, the derivative Spiritual Church. Treated of, AE 272:5.
Zion, the mountain of My holiness () = the Celestial Kingdom, which is in the good of love: this Kingdom is the inmost of Heaven, and the inmost of the Church. AE 850:3.

He that is left in Zion... (). By Zion, and Jerusalem, is signified the Church; by Zion, the Church with those who are in the good of love; and by Jerusalem, the Church with those who are in truths from this good. To wash away the excrement of the daughters of Zion = to purify from evils those in the Church who are in the good of love... AE 475:10.
This is why the city of David was built upon a mountain, and why that mountain, which was called mount Zion, = the Inmost Heaven.
These things (in ) are said of Zion, by which is signified the Celestial Church.
In the Word in Heaven, instead of Zion, and Jerusalem, there is the Church as to the Word, and as to doctrine from the Word.

A lamb standing upon the mount Zion () = the Lord in the New Heaven... By the mountain of Zion is signified the Heaven where are those who are in love to the Lord. ( = the presence of the Lord in Heaven and in the Church to separate the good from the evil, and to execute the Judgment... The mount Zion = Heaven and the Church where the Lord reigns through His Divine truth. AE 850.)

In the middle of Canaan was the city Zion, and below it the city Jerusalem, both upon a mountain; and therefore by Zion and Jerusalem are signified the inmost things of the Church. And as the Church in Heaven makes a one with the Church on earth, by Zion, and Jerusalem is meant the Church in both; but by Zion the Church as to love; and by Jerusalem, the Church as to the derivative doctrine. It is called mount Zion, because by a mountain is signified love.
That by mount Zion, are signified Heaven and the Church. Fully illustrated.
The daughter of Zion () = the Celestial Church.
Zion, in the Word, = the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, thus also the Celestial Church; and Jerusalem, the Spiritual Kingdom, and the Spiritual Church.
Zion, and the daughter of Zion = the Celestial Church.
I will return to Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem (). By Zion, here, is meant the Celestial Church; and by Jerusalem, that Church as to the doctrine of truth. AE 652:12.
The daughters of Zion () = the Celestial Church, and the things of it; here, perverted.
Zion = the Church.
Zion () = the Church as to the Word.
The inhabitress of Zion () = the like as the daughter of Zion, namely, the Celestial Church, that is, the Church which is in the good of love to the Lord. AE 326:3.
Rise and thresh, daughter of Zion () = the dispersion of evil with those who are of the Church... The daughter of Zion = the Church that is in the affection of good.
The daughter of Zion () = the Church that is in love to the Lord.
The mountain of Zion () = the Church, to which they are invited.
Zion () = Heaven, whence these things are.
The mountains of Zion () = where the goods of celestial love are.
For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah () = the Celestial Church, and its doctrine.
Zion () = the Church that is in the good of love to the Lord.
Jerusalem () = the Church as to the truths of doctrine; Zion, the Church as to the goods of love.
Jehovah shall bless thee out of Zion () = the blessing that is from the good of love; for Zion = the Church as to the good of love...
To sing in the height of Zion () = internal celestial joy; that is, such as there is in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom.
Praise Jehovah, Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion ()... Jerusalem = the Church as to the truths of doctrine; and Zion, the Church as to the goods of love.

I have anointed My king upon Zion, the mountain of My holiness () = the Celestial Kingdom which is in the good of love: this Kingdom is the inmost of Heaven, and the inmost of the Church. ( = the Lord's Human as to Divine truth proceeding from the Divine good... and His derivative Kingdom over all things of Heaven and the Church. AE 684:12.)
The mountains of Zion () = the Divine good; therefore like the dew of Hermon that descended upon the mountains of Zion = the conjunction of truth and good.
Do good in Thy good pleasure unto Zion; build Thou the walls of Jerusalem () = to restore the Church by leading it into the good of love, and by teaching it in the truths of doctrine.
O Zion, that proclaimest good tidings () = the Church that is in the good of love to the Lord.

As... from the Divine good proceeds the Divine truth, therefore the mountain of Zion was built above Jerusalem; and by the mountain of Zion, in the Word, is signified the Church that is in the good of love to the Lord; and by Jerusalem, the Church that is in truths from that good...
As the mountain of Zion = the Divine good, and the Church as to it, it is said...

As the mountain of Zion, and Jerusalem, were built, as far as possible, according to the form of Heaven, it is evident what is signified in... the mountain of Zion, the sides of the north, the City of the great king ()...
As mountains = the goods of celestial love, and hills the goods of spiritual love... Zion was upon a mountain, and Jerusalem was upon the mountainous places below it.

Exult, daughter of Zion; shout, daughter of Jerusalem () = the advent of the Lord, and the establishment of the Church by Him with those who are in the good of love and the derivative truths of doctrine.
In the mountain of Zion there shall be escape () = love to the Lord from which there is Salvation.
Zion = the good of the Church; and Jerusalem, its truth.

The mountain of Zion shall be glad () = the Celestial Church, in which are those who are in love to the Lord... Encompass ye Zion, encircle her = to embrace, from love, the things of this Church. Further described.
Zion = the Church where the good of love reigns; and Jerusalem, where the truth of doctrine. AE 540:end.

The elders of the daughter of Zion () = the wise and the intelligent in the Church; abstractedly, wisdom and intelligence. The daughters of Zion and the virgins of Jerusalem = those in the Church who are in the affection of good and truth; abstractedly, these affections themselves.
The daughters of Zion = the Church as to the affections of celestial good; consequently, the affections of good that are of the Celestial Church.

The sons of Zion () = those who are in genuine truths and through which they have the good of love; for Zion = the Celestial Church which is in the good of love to the Lord through genuine truths. AE 650:40.
Zion () = the Celestial Church, which is in the good of love to the Lord, and which Church the Jewish nation represented.
David and the succeeding kings were buried in Zion (Illustrated.) the reason of which was that Zion = the Celestial Church and Heaven, where the Lord is.
In Zion will I make the horn of David to bud () = the power of Divine truth from Him in Heaven and the Church.
The daughter of Zion () = the Celestial Church, the essential of which is the good of love.
Zion, where David was, = the inmost of the Church, which is called its Celestial.

The bringing of the ark into Zion () = ascent into the Third Heaven... For Zion represented the inmost of the Church, and from this the inmost of the Heavens, which is the Third Heaven, where the Angels are in the good of love to the Lord...
The stones of Zion () = Divine truths; for by Zion, upon which Jehovah will have mercy, is meant the Church that is in celestial love.
Zion and Jerusalem = the Church and its doctrine.
Zion () = a new Church.
The daughter of Zion () = the Church that, from the good of love, is in the truths of doctrine.
Zion () = the Church that is in love to the Lord, and is thence called the Celestial Church.
Fear not, inhabitant of Zion () = that truths will not be perverted in those of the Church who are in celestial love and the derivative truths.
The multitude of all nations that fight against the mountain of Zion () = the falsities of evil that fight against the goods of the Church... The mountain of Zion = the Church as to the good of love.
Look upon Zion, the city of our set feast, let thine eyes see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation (). Zion and Jerusalem = Heaven and the Church as to the good of love, and the truth of doctrine.
The daughter of Zion () = the Church that is in the affection of truth from the good of love.
The sons of Zion (treated of in ) = those in love to the Lord and thence in truths.
Zion () = those who from the Lord are in the good of love.

Put on thy strength, Zion; put on the garments of thy beauty, Jerusalem, the city of holiness (). By Zion is meant the Church that is in the good of love to the Lord; and the truth from this good is signified by the strength... and the truths of doctrine of this Church are signified by the garments of beauty... The daughter of Zion () = those who, from the Lord, are in the affection of truth from the good of love.

That by the mountain of Zion is signified Heaven and the Church where the Lord reigns through His Divine truth, is from the fact that Zion was the city that David built, and in which he afterwards dwelt, and which was therefore called the city of David; and David represented the Lord as to the royalty, which is the Divine truth... This also was why the ark... was transferred into this city. (Continued. See Jerusalem.)
Mountains, and, primarily, the mountain of Zion = love to the Lord.
That Zion = Heaven and the Church where the Lord reigns through His Divine truth. Fully illustrated. AE 863:2. AE 863:3. AE 899:10. AE 946:2. AE 1057:5.
Zion, in the following passages, = the Church as to the Word.
